headword: {遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}え

definitions.explanation: Changing an organism's genes by inserting or altering DNA. In daily life the word is met on food labels: soy and corn products state whether they are genetically modified.

examples.japanese: {遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}えでない⟦{大豆|だいず}→大豆：10536_daizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っています→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: We use soybeans that are not genetically modified.

examples.japanese: {遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}え⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{賛否|さんぴ}→賛否：14233_sanpi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Opinions on genetically modified crops are divided.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}え⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原料|げんりょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧づけられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, foods made with genetically modified ingredients must be labeled.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}え⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧: GM crops
- {遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}え⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: GM food
- {遺伝子組|いでんしく}み{換|か}えでない: non-GMO (the wording on labels)

WRITING:
- Labels and laws often write {遺伝子組換|いでんしくみかえ} without the okurigana. A newer technique is ゲノム⟦{編集|へんしゅう}→編集：04439_henshuu⟧ (genome editing), which is regulated separately.
